content_sections.heading: About Kanniyakumari RD
content_sections.text: The Rural Development and Panchayat Department (ஊரக வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் ஊராட்சித் துறை) works at district level in Kanniyakumari District, Tamil Nadu. It has issued this notice to fill an Office Assistant post. The notice is posted on the district website, kanniyakumari.nic.in.

content_sections.heading: Kanniyakumari RD Office Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted as on 01.07.2026. Candidates must have completed 18 years of age. The maximum age is 35 years for the categories listed in the notice: Item 7 of the notice sets out the educational qualification and refers to Rule 5(2)(a). The text of this item cannot be read clearly in the notice copy. Candidates should check the exact wording in the official notification (PDF) before applying. The application form asks candidates to tick one category: SC(W), SC.W(Widow) or SC.W(Destitute Widow). It also asks whether the candidate is a destitute widow, differently abled, visually impaired or an ex-serviceman. For the full post-specific eligibility, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: According to the note on the application form, candidates have to produce their certificates and original documents at the interview (நேர்காணல்).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kanniyakumari RD Office Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from kanniyakumari.nic.in . The form is headed "அலுவலக உதவியாளர் பணியிடத்திற்கான விண்ணப்பம்" (Application for the Office Assistant post). Paste a passport-size photograph in the space provided. Fill in your name, gender, father's, husband's or guardian's name, date of birth and age, educational qualification, address, and phone and mobile numbers. Tick your category: SC(W), SC.W(Widow) or SC.W(Destitute Widow). Answer yes or no for destitute widow, differently abled, visually impaired and ex-serviceman. Sign the declarations. They confirm that every detail is true, that you accept action by the selection committee if any detail is found false before or after selection, and that no criminal case is registered against you. Write the place and date, and sign the form. Submit the form to the office named in the notice (PIN 629 001) between 10.00 am and 5.45 pm, so that it reaches the office by 5.45 pm on 6 November 2026. Bring your certificates and the original documents to the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which category is the Office Assistant post reserved for?
faq.answer: The notice reserves the post for SC.W.DW. The application form describes this category as SC Woman (Destitute Widow).

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale of the Kanniyakumari Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The post is on the scale of pay of Rs. 15,700 - 57,000.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 18 years of age as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on 1 July 2026 for the SC(W), SC.W(W) and SC.W(DW) categories.

faq.question: Q5. When can I start submitting the application?
Q6. What time are applications received?
faq.answer: Applications are received between 10.00 am and 5.45 pm. The final deadline is 5.45 pm on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What does the declaration on the form cover?
faq.answer: You confirm that all details are true and that no criminal case is registered against you. You also accept action by the selection committee if any detail is found false before or after selection.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring your certificates and the original documents. The form says they must be produced at the interview.
